replace.html:
Karibu. We plan your Tanzania trip from start to finish

Your Tanzania Trip began with an internship in Arusha. Tijs Krops and Edrian Waterman spent it at Kilimanjaro Nature Tours, helping founder Baraka Dalali and his crew prepare for international guests. The work did not stop when the internship did. Today we plan and book your trip from the Netherlands, and Baraka's team runs it on the ground. Safari in the north or the south, the Great Migration, Kilimanjaro, Zanzibar: every trip is built around you.

Travel without worries with the Hakuna Matata Package

Every trip includes our free Hakuna Matata Package: a complete travel file, pick-up and drop-off at the airport, a private guide, 24/7 support during your trip and help when a flight booked through us is disrupted. No add-on, no small print.

The team you meet in Tanzania

Baraka Dalali founded Kilimanjaro Nature Tours in Arusha. His guides, drivers and mountain crew are the people who pick you up and drive you through the parks. Our local partner Kilimanjaro Nature Tours is rated 5.0 on Tripadvisor (208 reviews, checked 27 October 2026).

We have visited more than 100 hotels and lodges ourselves, so we know which one suits you. Tell us how you like to travel and we put the trip together.

items.q: What does a trip with Your Tanzania Trip cost?
items.a: It depends on the parks, the season, the comfort level and the group size. As a guide: our 7-day northern safari starts at $1,599 per person and the 11-day safari with Zanzibar at $2,181, both based on 6 travellers in low season and excluding international flights. Your proposal shows the exact price for your group and dates. Fair prices, no middlemen.

items.q: How does the free travel proposal work?
items.a: Tell us your wishes through the form or on WhatsApp. Within 24 hours you receive a proposal with a day-by-day plan, the lodges and the price. It is free and without obligation, and we adjust it until it fits. We design your trip, you decide.

Our local partner Kilimanjaro Nature Tours in Arusha, founded by Baraka Dalali. On safari you travel with a private, English-speaking guide in your own safari vehicle. Kilimanjaro climbs are led by licensed guides with their own crew of cooks and porters.

items.q: When is the best time to visit Tanzania?
items.a: The dry months, June to October and December to February, give the easiest wildlife viewing and the sunniest beach days; they are also the busiest. March and November are quieter, with moderate rates. April and May bring the long rains and the lowest prices: green parks, few vehicles, and showers that rarely last all day.

items.q: What is included in the price?
items.a: Your accommodation, meals during the safari, park fees, a private guide and vehicle, game drives and airport transfers. Not included: international flights, visas and travel insurance. Each trip page lists exactly what is in and what is out.

items.q: How do I book, and what do I pay when?
items.a: Once you are happy with the proposal, you confirm and pay a deposit. The balance is due before departure. You receive an invoice and a complete travel file from us, and our team in Arusha takes over the moment you land.
